title: git kura close — envelope data
description: Command-specific schema for the data payload of `git kura close <key> --json`, nested under the common envelope's data field.

worktreePath.description: Absolute path of the worktree that was removed.

removedWorktree.description: Whether this invocation removed the git worktree directory.

removedBranch.description: Whether this invocation deleted the git branch.

removedMetadata.description: Whether this invocation deleted the kura metadata file.

releasedSealCount.description: Number of path seals released from the seal store.
